notes: Malformed header, the same shape as FlowDefinition's; whether it is filed was not searched.
decision: SysML 8.2.2.6.1 states DefinitionDeclaration : Definition Identification SubclassificationPart?. The SysML Xtext writes Identification? SubclassificationPart?; whether the '?' on Identification changes the language depends on Identification's rule, which is not in this pack, so it is not read as a disagreement. The clause's header lacks its '=' (`DefinitionDeclaration : Definition` followed directly by the body); the body is unambiguous and is taken as written. The rule is the clause as written.
